title: LLM-as-a-Judge structured output (one call, the criteria assigned to it)
description: The judge returns ONLY this object (structured output / responseSchema). Code post-validates it: unknown criterion ids are dropped; cited ids not in the offered evidence list are dropped; a PASS/FAIL without at least one surviving citation is downgraded to NEEDS_REVIEW; a PASS on a criterion whose required decisive fields are unverified is downgraded to NEEDS_REVIEW; a judge outcome never overrides a deterministic outcome (conflict → NEEDS_REVIEW with both rationales). self_reported_confidence is stored, never used as a gate.

criterion_id.description: Must be one of the ids assigned in the prompt (enum injected per call).

cited_evidence_ids.description: Only ids from the EVIDENCE list in the prompt.

hypotheses_he.description: Possible explanations for a person to check — never conclusions.
